name: Jaareish
title: Benjaminitic Patriarch
summary: Jaareish is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as one of the sons of Jeroham, a descendant of Benjamin. He is part of the genealogical lists documenting the tribe of Benjamin and its family lines. He has no known narrative role beyond his place in the genealogies.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Jaareish is listed as one of the sons of Jeroham in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin, who lived in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Benjamin in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Jaareish belongs to the Benjamite families recorded as residing in Jerusalem according to the genealogies in Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Tribal Register of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: As part of the detailed genealogy in 1 Chronicles, Jaareish is mentioned to document the continuity and heritage of the tribe of Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: Family Heads in Benjamin
keyEvents.description: The genealogy in which Jaazaniah is included identifies the family heads among the Benjamites who were leaders of their clans.
